facts.fact: Nigeria 24 reports that the National Population Commission's launched VitalReg platform integrates with the National Identity Management Commission, and self-service birth registration requires the child to already hold a National Identification Number.

Nigeria 24 reports that the National Population Commission has launched VitalReg, a fully digital platform for birth registration replacing paper, usable through a self-service portal or any of 4,011 NPC centres across the 774 local government areas.
Nigeria 24 reports that VitalReg handles death and stillbirth notifications digitally, alongside birth registration.
Nigeria 24 states that roughly 43 per cent of annual births and over 80 per cent of deaths in Nigeria go unregistered, a national rate not tied to the digital system.
